compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

Complete ADR 0098 for LLM execution after the command/store cutover. Many LLM operations currently call `LLMConfig.from_env()` independently, even though `LLMRuntime`, `ProviderSession`, gate config scoping, and snapshot composition already exist.

The goal is one behavior-bearing snapshot/context per public operation, not deletion of a legitimate top-level composition convenience. Ambient compatibility may remain only at an explicitly approved boundary and must delegate to the central composer.

## Approach

- Derive a focused LLM config projection from the existing snapshot/schema/provenance; pair it with existing non-serializable `LLMRuntime`.
- Thread that context through gate/workflow/runner entry points so subcalls inherit operation policy rather than re-resolving it.
- Preserve ProviderSession/provider-native auth, budgets, cache/output/retry behavior, tracing, and secret exclusions.
- Add consumer-level metamorphic tests covering multi-step runs and failure/retry paths.
- Delete the shadow switch/function and migrated ambient-resolution branches after parity; tighten the existing ownership gate and documentation.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_operation_config.py` — remove diagnostic shadow machinery after cutover.
- `src/rebar/llm/` plus CLI/MCP LLM entry modules — derive and thread one snapshot/config/runtime context.
- Focused LLM/provider/cache/fallback/workflow tests and cross-surface contract tests.
- `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`, `docs/config.md`, and `docs/architecture.md`.

## Testing

Happy path: CLI, MCP, and Python multi-step gates use one snapshot and preserve current provider/cache/retry/output behavior. Metamorphic edge: mutate every behavior-bearing LLM setting after composition and prove the active run is stable while the next observes it. Failure edges cover missing/conflicting auth, retries, fallback, workflow subcalls, and secret/non-secret boundary leakage.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each public CLI, MCP, and Python LLM/gate operation composes one snapshot/context; every subcall and workflow step receives its projection/runtime without rereading environment/files/CWD.
- [ ] Mutating model/provider class, timeout, retry, cache, headers, tracing, or repository settings after composition cannot change an in-progress multi-step run; the next operation observes the mutation.
- [ ] Explicit supplied config/snapshot stays authoritative, and missing/conflicting decision-bearing provider/auth composition fails before an external call without anonymous/cross-provider fallback.
- [ ] `LLMRuntime` and `ProviderSession` remain the live-auth and provider-resource owners; no secret/live capability enters snapshot bytes, fingerprints, repr, logs, exceptions, or schemas.
- [ ] `emit_shadow_snapshot`, its migration switch, diagnostic-only production call sites, and migrated below-boundary `LLMConfig.from_env` branches are deleted. Any retained `from_env` public composition wrapper delegates once to the central composer and is structurally allowlisted by exact symbol/rationale.
- [ ] The ownership gate fails on synthetic direct/aliased ambient reloads and carries zero post-cutover legacy exceptions.
- [ ] Consumer-level metamorphic tests plus focused LLM/provider/cache/fallback/workflow suites, default suite, lint, typecheck, complexity, and module-size gates pass; docs and ADR 0098 describe the authoritative state rather than shadow mode.
